selection_rule: Reuse the deterministic cross-baseline engineering subset shared with ORLM/OptMATH/DeepOR; retain every selected ID and record unsupported inputs explicitly.
common_comparison_scope: NLP4LP records suitable for full natural-language-to-model generation; OR-R1-native Pass@1/Pass@8/mj@8 remain separate from this repository's scalar-grounding metrics.
eligibility_rule: Natural-language problem text must be present; no outcome-based filtering.
orr1_transductive_training_warning: The official OR-R1 TGRPO stage is trained on the union of all official test sets, including the full 242-row official NLP4LP test split (see docs/ORR1_PROVENANCE.md). This manifest's IDs come from this repository's own PaMOP-derived NLP4LP subset, not the official split. The official datasets/testset/nlp4lp.jsonl carries an 'ori' provenance field, but it is the constant string '14_nlp4lp' on all 242 rows (verified 2026-08-13), not a per-instance identifier, so it cannot be used to cross-reference these pilot_ids against the official split by inspection alone; a text-level match against this repository's raw NLP4LP problem text would be required before any faithful-TGRPO run against this manifest.
